task: Explore: new venture gitconfig-include-check (which [includeIf] lines git follows in a repository, and why)
errors: Diff test first failed at seed 218: git reports a bad line in ~/.gitconfig before reading a gitdir include because of a very early system+global read with no repository (trace2). Modelled it.
Seed 1,788: git parses .git/config alone (repository-format check) before the main read. Modelled it.
The symlink unit test first assumed git -C sees the typed path; real git uses the typed path only when $PWD names the top folder. Fixed the test and added a gitdir-symlink finding.
run_venture_tests flagged two unguarded object-map lookups (SEVERITY_ORDER); switched to a Map.

doc_friction.issue: The header says to add a new line with sync_tree_counts.py, but that script only checks; it does not insert. I added the sorted line by hand.

notes: Explore idea: gitconfig includeIf checker, a fourth git/editor file explainer next to gitignore, gitattributes and editorconfig. The engine reimplements config.c parsing, reading order, include/includeIf (gitdir, gitdir/i, onbranch, hasconfig with the populate_remote_urls pass and forbid rule), the depth limit and the two hidden early reads. Oracle: git config --list --show-origin --show-scope (git 2.43.0). Seeds 1-3000 were used while building and ended with no difference. Held out, seeds 10001-15000: 5000/5000 agree (4141 read through, 1235 with a matched includeIf; 760 bad-line, 74 depth and 25 forbid fatals), 2m23s. New real-git finding: gitdir:~/work/ through a symlinked ~/work applies at the repository top folder but not in a subfolder or with git -C (strbuf_add_absolute_path uses $PWD only when it equals cwd). The CLI --verify matched git on this container's own config (23 values). Local checks: run_venture_tests.py gitconfig-include-check passed (34 tests), check_posts ok, sync_tree_counts --check ok, gitattributes-explainer page test ok after the cross-link. No separate agent doc: README and llms.txt carry what the next run needs.
